In what year and city was the First Zion.question: In what year and city was the First Zionist Congress held, and who convened it?
In what year and city was the First Zion.answer: It was held in 1897, convened by Theodor Herzl (the Congress took place in Basel, associated with the Basel declaration).
In what year and city was the First Zion.evidence: His usage of "Zionism" was later popularized when convening the 1897 First Zionist Congress
